newsitem.title: BELGIUM: UM division wins Peruvian contract.
newsitem.headline: UM division wins Peruvian contract.

text.p: UM Engineering, a division of Belgian non-ferrous metals group Union Miniere, said on Friday it won a contract from Peru's Refineria de Cajamarquilla to supply engineering and equipment.
It gave no financial details but said in a statement the deal would result in a 20 percent capacity increase of the Peruvian company's existing zinc cellhouse.
UM Engineering specialises in extractive metallurgy of non-ferrous metals, the manufacture of copper semis, zinc products and alloys, bulk storage and environmental protection.
